text:
camille: quick heads-up — integrating quickstart and hit wildly inconsistent SDK error shapes. python surfaces ValueError('401'), ts gives generic Error with .status, go returns an opaque map. makes middleware + retry policies brittle.

hugo: can you paste a tiny repro and whether this is auth vs rate-limit vs validation?

camille: mostly 401 and 429, sometimes 422. example: token exchange -> /complete -> sometimes plain text 401, sometimes JSON error, retry header often missing for 429. snippets: 

python:
```python
try:
    client.complete(prompt)
except Exception as e:
    # currently ValueError('401 Unauthorized') or ValueError('429 Too Many Requests')
    handle(e)
```

ts:
```ts
client.complete(prompt).catch(err => {
  // err.message 'Request failed' and sometimes err.status === 401
  // no stable class to branch on
})
```

faiza: this blocks writing a single retry middleware. proposal: standardize typed errors across SDKs and a small, flat error payload shape. minimal SDK exception surface: status (int), code (string, machine token), message (string), meta (flat map), should_retry (bool), recommended_backoff_ms (int).

hugo: agree. mapping table suggestion: 401 -> RedwoodAuthError (codes like auth.invalid_token), 403 -> RedwoodPermissionError, 400/422 -> RedwoodBadRequestError (set is_validation_error=true and include field_hints), 429 -> RedwoodRateLimitError (set should_retry=true and include retry_after if present), 502/503/504 -> RedwoodTransientError (should_retry=true).

camille: +1 for RFC7807-compatible base: {type,title,status,detail,instance,extensions} but keep extensions flat and copy into meta so SDKs can hydrate easily. also prefer short error.code tokens (auth.token_expired, rate.limit_exceeded).

faiza: migration plan: 1) add a compatibility shim in SDK HTTP layer that maps legacy responses and status/message patterns to typed exceptions; 2) ship as opt-in flag (typedErrors: true / enable_typed_errors) in next minor; 3) warn users for two minor cycles then flip default. include unit tests for python/ts/go and a quickstart sample showing try/catch by class.

hugo: small ergonomics ask: SDK exceptions should be instanceof-able (or subclass-able) in each language and still inherit from existing base so old catch-all code keeps working. also include clear toString()/message content for logs but rely on code/meta for logic.

camille: and telemetry: SDKs should tag traces with error.code and set metric labels for `error_class` and `should_retry` so we can alert on actionable failures.

faiza: timeline? onboarding tickets are piling up.

hugo: I'll open an umbrella RFC+issue today with the mapping table and example payloads. aim: RFC by EOD, shims + tests within 10 business days, opt-in beta in next minor.

sdk-prod-bot: created DEVEX-2201: "sdk-typed-errors-flat-mapping-and-retry-metadata" (assignee: hugo)

camille: will drop a tiny repro gist and a short quickstart PR once the umbrella issue is up. thanks! :sparkles:
